observation: The sheet does not exhibit the dramatic wind-driven billowing implied by the scene description; in the still frame it appears as a crumpled, low-energy cloth mass near the line.
expected_behavior: A large bed sheet pinned on a clothesline in strong gusting wind should show broad inflated billows, tension lines radiating from attachment points, readable rippling waves, and a silhouette consistent with forceful airflow.
actual_behavior: The cloth silhouette is compact and lumpy, with weak large-scale inflation and little visible tension structure near the attachment area. The pose reads closer to mild sagging/crumpling than violent flapping.
